findings.text: health.spec 'closed client' calls createTestDb() outside the spec's opened/afterEach cleanup; if the 200 assertion fails before t.dispose(), that client and its temp dir leak for the rest of the run
MIGRATIONS_FOLDER is now defined identically in test-db.ts, auth-harness.ts and cli/admin-create.ts; the record expects auth-harness to be deleted in t-7, which leaves two copies
test-db.spec's MIGRATIONS_FOLDER === migrationsFolder() assertion depends on vitest running from the repo root; that is intended here but will break if the test cwd changes
Ports with leading zeros (e.g. 'localhost:00080') are accepted as port 80; harmless for a loopback guard, but this case is untested
The reject table goes past the contract with 'localhost:0', 'localhost:65536' and leading/trailing-space rows, so the port-range check and anchoring are actually exercised
